excerpt.zh: 追踪着与[from.Planet.GetName]上的装置完全一致的通讯频率找到的这一位置，而这里又发现了一台受损的装置。进行研究可以取得对他们的破坏性环境改造能力更深入的洞见。
excerpt.en: An identical communications frequency to the one emitted by the construct found on [from.Planet.GetName] has been traced to this site, where another damaged device has been located. Studying it will yield further insight into their destructive terraforming cap

texts.zh: 追踪着与[from.Planet.GetName]上的装置完全一致的通讯频率找到的这一位置，而这里又发现了一台受损的装置。进行研究可以取得对他们的破坏性环境改造能力更深入的洞见。
texts.en: An identical communications frequency to the one emitted by the construct found on [from.Planet.GetName] has been traced to this site, where another damaged device has been located. Studying it will yield further insight into their destructive terraforming capabilities.

texts.zh:
我们顺利地在[from.GetName]发现了另一台受损的环境改造装置。与起初的那台不同，这台装置中还剩有一些燃料以供研究，这才让我们明白其输出放射性的驱动力是暗物质。

该装置通过关键的分子键迁移来加速目标资源的生长。该过程牺牲周围生物圈的细胞完整性来促进其发展。
texts.en:
We have successfully uncovered another damaged terraforming device on [from.GetName]. Unlike the original construct, this one has retained some of its fuel source for study, revealing Dark Matter as the driving force of its radiation output.

The device accelerates growth of targeted resources by metastasizing key molecular bonds. This promotes their development at the expense of the surrounding biosphere's cellular integrity.

texts.zh: 就资源开采而言，这台装置对星球稳定度的完全漠视相当鼓舞人心。
texts.en: The sheer disregard this device shows to planetary stability in the face of resource exploitation is inspirational.

texts.zh:
这台机器通过将辐射波导通过晶化折射阵列，在避免行星核心坍塌的前提下以引力分子操纵来改造目标星球。

恢复的记录显示出了第四个未爆装置的位置。
texts.en:
By channeling radiation waves through a crystallized refractory array, this machine can terraform its target using gravitational molecular manipulation without collapsing the planetary core in on itself.

Recovered records indicate the location of a fourth, undetonated device.

texts.zh: 至于这台装置是如何实现又如何避免行星级引力坍缩的我们还不清楚。也许在剩下的通讯地点能够找到答案。
texts.en: How the device manages to do this and prevent gravitational collapse on a planetary scale remains unclear. This answer may be found at the remaining communications site.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.GetName]上又顺利取回了另一件受损的环境改造装置，由于折射阵列损坏导致激活失败，它被生长出的晶体包裹着。

通过对这台仪器的密切调查，我们确定了用于聚焦辐射瞄准的方法。通过利用可控调制反馈回路，该结构能够直接瞄准并刺激预设资源的增长。
texts.en:
We have successfully uncovered another damaged terraforming device on [from.GetName], encased in crystal growths caused by a misfire from a broken refractor array.

Through close observation of the apparatus, we have identified the methods used for focused radiation targeting. By utilizing controlled modulating feedback loops, the construct is able to directly target and stimulate the growth of a pre-determined resource.

texts.zh:
以此可以在避免行星全面重力坍缩的前提下进行高强度环境改造。

恢复的记录显示出了第四台未爆装置的位置。
texts.en:
This allows for high-intensity terraforming, without the risk of complete planetary gravitational collapse.

Recovered records indicate the location of a fourth, undetonated device.

texts.zh: 然而，产生这种辐射的确切物质仍未确定；尽管激活失败，这台装置的燃料储备还是耗尽了。这个答案或许能在余下的通信站点找到。
texts.en: However, the exact substance used to generate this radiation remains unidentified; the device's fuel reserves depleted despite its misfire. This answer may be found at the remaining communications site.

texts.zh: [from.Planet.GetName]上找到的设施发出的通讯频率还指向这个地点，我们在这里又找到了一台受损的设备。进行研究可以取得对他们的破坏性环境改造能力更深入的洞见。
texts.en: The communications frequency emitted by the construct found on [from.Planet.GetName] has also been traced to this site, where another damaged device has been located. Studying it will yield further insight into their destructive terraforming capabilities.
